name: the forest
title: A Quiet Forest
description: the sea is only a sound now.

firstVisit.log: somewhere ahead, water runs over stones.

explore.name: look around
nothingLog: the trees all look the same now. nothing new.

text: dead branches lie everywhere under the trees, dry enough to burn. you could collect some.
between mossy stones, a small spring. the water is clear and cold.

activities.name: collect wood
log: bark and twigs, dry enough to burn.

activities.name: drink water
log: cold water from the spring, tasting of stone.
you drink until your teeth ache.
